manifestations.description: weakness and spasticity in all four limbs
some motor power present in all limbs (recovery to grade 2-grade 3)
sensation was diminished but not absent
mentally of normal intelligence and stable personality; speech normal
able with great difficulty to stand and shuffle a few steps
spends most of the day in her wheelchair
able to raise herself out of the chair and to walk a few steps with the aid of a tripod walking support; able to crawl up stairs; can feed herself and prepare simple meals
unable to propel the wheelchair, unable to bath herself or to get into and out of bed unaided
partial but not good control over bowel actions and micturition and needs to wear napkins
condition has on several occasions induced her to thoughts of suicide

treatments_received: Admitted to surgical 'A' unit Princess Mary Hospital
Transferred from surgical ward to orthopaedic ward on 24.2.81
Transferred to Margaret Trench Rehabilitation Centre for physiotherapy on 8.6.81
Discharged from Margaret Trench Rehabilitation Centre after about 9 months
treatments_future: bi-annual inspections by a consultant (private medical attention)
private medical treatment for complications and inter-current illnesses

losses.description: Quadriparalysis/weakness and spasticity in all four limbs with diminished sensation and motor impairment
Spends most of the day in a wheelchair; able to walk only a few steps with aid; unable to propel wheelchair unaided
Unable to bath herself or to get into and out of bed unaided; requires attendant care

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Limited ability to perform household activities; can prepare simple meals but needs assistance for other tasks
No prospect of being fit to take up gainful employment

comparable_cases.injury_description: Described the 'disaster' category where the victim requires constant care and attention and is incapable of ever leading or appreciating an independent adult life.
